newsitem.title: USA: AOL says drops plan to share users' phone numbers.
newsitem.headline: AOL says drops plan to share users' phone numbers.

text.p: America Online Inc. said Thursday it was dropping plans to sell subscriber phone numbers to certain business partners for telemarketing purposes.

Responding to a mounting outcry from customers and privacy advocates, AOL said it had never planned to make the phone numbers of its more than 8 million subsribers worldwide "available for rental to telemarketers."

"The only calls we intended for you to receive would have been from AOL and a limited number of quality-controlled AOL partners," the company said in a five-paragraph statement apparently crafted for its sign-on pages.

"However, upon further reflection, we today decided to change our plans. We will not provide lists of our members' telephone numbers even to our partners. The only calls you might receive will be from us," the company said.
